intuition: Hash each integer into a bucket and keep each key at most once within that bucket.

brute_force.approach: Store all keys in one list and scan it for membership, insertion, and removal.
brute_force.time: add O(n), remove O(n), contains O(n)

optimal.approach: Use separate chaining across a fixed bucket array and search only the selected bucket.
optimal.time: add O(1) average, remove O(1) average, contains O(1) average

edge_cases: Adding an existing key leaves the set unchanged.
Removing a missing key is a no-op.
